objective: Distinguish useful conditional state from unconditional terminal-level anchoring, while respecting positive price-ratio support
target: Original q[t+h]-q[t] in percentage points, h=24/60/120 calendar months
ratio: R=1-q/100, the monthly mean positive underlying price ratio
new_model: E[R[t+h]|R[t]]=exp(a_h+b_h*log(R[t])) fitted by Poisson quasi-mean objective on continuous positive ratios; no count interpretation
nonlinear_scope: This is a mean/support diagnostic nonlinear in q, not a replacement for the original linear-only specification or economic mechanism validation
training: Exact original LH-LEVEL expanding matured-label masks, minimum36 and ten rows per parameter; no new origins or sample extensions
terminal_anchor: Mean q[j+h] on the identical matured training rows, never a fixed zero or full-sample equilibrium
fit: Profile intercept analytically; solve monotone normalized weighted-mean score for slope by fixed bracketing/bisection; no penalty, slope-range restriction, clipping or selected transformation
support_gate: Every predicted ratio must be positive and finite; retain numerical/domain failures. Report q rounding to100 separately; never clip
loss_gate: Score all methods against all three benchmarks on exactly matched successful origins, retain requested/failed counts. No deployment decision from exposed-history losses
interpretation_gate: If Novo fails the terminal anchor, conditional-state information is not established despite wins over persistence or mean change. Gains over all three benchmarks remain exploratory and require measurement/prospective challenges
sample_policy: All original eligible LH-LEVEL samples; original blocked rows and unavailable ten-year evaluation retained
nonoverlap: Every nonempty original origin-grid modulo horizon phase; no favorable anchor selection or independent-experiment claim
